name: Shelly Dimmer Gen4 US UL-Certified
summary: 120V in-wall trailing-edge smart dimmer, 200W, Wi-Fi/Zigbee/BLE + Matter, with power metering; neutral required.

extra.ul_source: UL claim from product title only; KB specs don't list a UL file
extra.output_type_note: KB says trailing-edge; semiconductor type not stated (triac_dimmer used as generic phase-cut)
extra.load_limits: dimmable LED 150W; incandescent/halogen 200W; iron-core xfmr 200VA; electronic xfmr 200W
extra.matter_vs_zigbee: Matter is default profile; 5 presses switches to Zigbee profile

gotchas: 200 W max (150 W for dimmable LED) — not for big chandeliers or many-can circuits
Neutral required — no no-neutral option in this model
Trailing-edge only; groups of lamps must be same model/wattage or flicker/uneven dimming results
Matter is default; Zigbee is a separate profile you switch to (5 button presses)
No add-on port; for DIN-rail 2-channel use Shelly Pro Dimmer 2PM
best_for: retrofitting a US dimmer box with neutral for ≤150W LED with Matter or Zigbee
